prompt:
Workflow step: Use the fixed robot arm to pick up the mold from workbench and move it to tray.
Inspection timing: before this step
Inspection location: workbench
What the inspection checks: Check whether a clean mold is on workbench.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: Centre foreground: a white plastic holder resting at an angle on a grey aluminium extrusion rail, carrying a rectangular plate with a grid of square wells (roughly four rows of three) holding pale blue-green liquid; the wells are uncapped and open. Attached to the plate's right end is a clear plate bearing a black-and-white square fiducial marker printed with "620". Behind it lies a dark gasket-like frame and a round white cap or disc on the bench. Lower left: a white circular platform with a ring groove, plus two metal dowel pins. Upper right: a white robot arm joint with black cabling; white posts and a black block at upper left. Background: white bench surfaces.
observations: The workbench contains a well plate with liquid instead of a clean mold.

args.observations: The workbench contains a well plate with liquid instead of a clean mold.
